subject: Physics
title: Kinematics (Motion in a Straight Line and in a Plane)
summary: Kinematics sirf yeh batata hai ki cheez KAISE chal rahi hai — position, velocity, acceleration — force ki baat nahi (woh Laws of Motion mein). Har sawal ek frame of reference se naapa jaata hai; ground frame default hai.
Distance scalar hai (path ki lambai), displacement vector hai (seedha start se end). Speed = distance/time, velocity = displacement/time. Instantaneous velocity = dx/dt, acceleration = dv/dt.

Constant acceleration par teen equations (v = u + at, s = ut + ½at², v² = u² + 2as) har jagah chalti hain — free fall mein a = g. Acceleration badal raha ho to calculus ya graph (area/slope) use karo.

Plane motion = do independent 1-D motions. Projectile mein horizontal velocity constant, vertical mein a = −g. Uniform circular motion mein speed constant par direction badalti hai, isliye centripetal acceleration v²/r centre ki taraf.

Vectors is chapter ki bhasha hai: addition (triangle/parallelogram), resolution (A cosθ, A sinθ), dot product (scalar, kaam/angle ke liye) aur cross product (vector, area/torque ke liye). Relative velocity v_AB = v_A − v_B se river, rain aur train ke sawal hal hote hain.

formulas.name: Average speed and velocity
formulas.formula: v_avg = total displacement / total time;   average speed = total distance / total time
formulas.mistake: Average speed ko (v₁ + v₂)/2 mat lo — sirf equal TIME intervals mein aisa hota hai. Equal distance par 2v₁v₂/(v₁ + v₂).

formulas.name: Instantaneous velocity and acceleration
formulas.formula: v = dx/dt,   a = dv/dt = v dv/dx = d²x/dt²
formulas.mistake: a = v dv/dx tab use karo jab v position ke function mein diya ho — t ke bina.

formulas.name: Equations of uniformly accelerated motion
formulas.formula: v = u + at;   s = ut + ½at²;   v² = u² + 2as;   s = (u + v)t/2
formulas.note: Sign convention ek baar fix karo (upar +ve to g = −10) aur poore sawal mein wahi rakho.

formulas.name: Distance in the nth second
formulas.when: Sirf n-wen second mein chali doori.
formulas.mistake: Ye nth second ki doori hai, n seconds ki total nahi.

formulas.name: Free fall and vertical throw
formulas.formula: Max height H = u²/2g;  time to top = u/g;  total time = 2u/g;  wapas usi speed u se aata hai
formulas.when: Upar phenki ya giraayi cheez (air resistance nahi).
formulas.mistake: Top par v = 0 hota hai, lekin a = g tab bhi hai — acceleration zero nahi.

formulas.name: Graphs
formulas.formula: x–t ka slope = velocity;  v–t ka slope = acceleration;  v–t ke neeche area = displacement;  a–t ke neeche area = Δv
formulas.note: v–t graph mein axis ke neeche wala area displacement mein minus, distance mein plus gino.

formulas.name: Vector resolution and unit vector
formulas.formula: A = A_x î + A_y ĵ + A_z k̂;  |A| = √(A_x² + A_y² + A_z²);  Â = A/|A|;  A_x = A cosθ, A_y = A sinθ
formulas.mistake: θ kis axis se naapa hai, check karo — y-axis se ho to cos/sin ulta ho jaate hain.

formulas.name: Vector addition (resultant)
formulas.formula: R = √(A² + B² + 2AB cosθ);   tan α = B sinθ / (A + B cosθ)
formulas.when: Do vectors jinke beech angle θ.
formulas.mistake: θ dono vectors ke TAIL milaakar naapo, tail-to-head nahi.

formulas.name: Dot (scalar) product
formulas.formula: A·B = AB cosθ = A_x B_x + A_y B_y + A_z B_z
formulas.mistake: Dot product scalar hai — iska answer kabhi î/ĵ mein nahi likhte.

formulas.name: Cross (vector) product
formulas.formula: A×B = AB sinθ n̂ = |î ĵ k̂; A_x A_y A_z; B_x B_y B_z|;   A×B = −B×A
formulas.when: Area of parallelogram = |A×B|, torque, perpendicular vector.
formulas.note: Order badalne se sign badalta hai; î×ĵ = k̂, ĵ×î = −k̂.

formulas.name: Relative velocity
formulas.formula: v_AB = v_A − v_B   (A ki velocity B ke frame se)
formulas.mistake: v_AB aur v_BA ulte hote hain; pehle decide karo kiska frame chahiye.

formulas.name: River crossing
formulas.formula: Shortest time: boat seedha paar → t = d/v_b, drift = v_r·d/v_b.   Shortest path (v_b > v_r): sinθ = v_r/v_b upstream, t = d/√(v_b² − v_r²)
formulas.mistake: Shortest time aur shortest path do alag cases hain — sawal dhyan se padho.

formulas.name: Projectile on level ground
formulas.formula: T = 2u sinθ/g;  H = u² sin²θ/2g;  R = u² sin2θ/g;  R_max = u²/g at θ = 45°
formulas.mistake: θ aur (90° − θ) par range same, lekin height aur time alag.

formulas.name: Projectile path equation
formulas.formula: y = x tanθ − g x² / (2u² cos²θ);   v at any time: v_x = u cosθ, v_y = u sinθ − gt
formulas.mistake: Top par v_y = 0, lekin v_x = u cosθ bacha rehta hai — speed zero nahi.

formulas.name: Horizontal projection from height h
formulas.formula: t = √(2h/g);  range = u√(2h/g);  ground par v = √(u² + 2gh)
formulas.mistake: Girne ka time horizontal speed par depend NAHI karta.

formulas.name: Uniform circular motion
formulas.formula: ω = 2π/T = 2πf;  v = ωr;  a_c = v²/r = ω²r (centre ki taraf)
formulas.mistake: Speed constant hai, velocity nahi — isliye acceleration zero nahi.

formulas.name: Non-uniform circular motion
formulas.formula: a_t = dv/dt (tangent),  a_c = v²/r,   a_net = √(a_t² + a_c²)
formulas.mistake: Sirf v²/r likh dena aadha answer hai jab speed badal rahi ho.

examples.title: Car accelerates
examples.problem: Car u = 10 m/s se 2 m/s² acceleration ke saath 5 s chalti hai. Final velocity aur doori?

examples.title: Ball upar phenki
examples.problem: Ball 20 m/s se seedhi upar phenki (g = 10 m/s²). Max height aur total time?
examples.solution: H = u²/2g = 400/20 = 20 m.  Total time = 2u/g = 4 s (2 s upar, 2 s neeche).

examples.title: Teesre second ki doori
examples.problem: Rest se a = 4 m/s² se chalti body teesre second mein kitna chalti hai?
examples.solution: s_n = u + (a/2)(2n − 1) = 0 + 2 × 5 = 10 m. (3 s ki total doori 18 m hoti — alag cheez.)

examples.title: Projectile ke teeno numbers
examples.problem: u = 20 m/s, θ = 30° (g = 10). Time of flight, max height, range?

examples.title: Nadi paar karna
examples.problem: Nadi 100 m chaudi, paani 3 m/s, boat (paani ke relative) 5 m/s. (a) Sabse kam time? drift? (b) Seedha saamne pahunchna ho to?
examples.solution: (a) Boat seedha paar: t = 100/5 = 20 s, drift = 3 × 20 = 60 m.  (b) Upstream angle sinθ = 3/5 ⇒ θ ≈ 36.9° (normal se); resultant = √(25 − 9) = 4 m/s, t = 100/4 = 25 s.

examples.title: Dot aur cross product
examples.problem: A = 3î + 4ĵ, B = î − 2ĵ + 2k̂. A·B, unke beech angle, aur |A×B|?

examples.title: Ghoomta pankha point
examples.problem: Point 0.5 m radius par 120 rpm se ghoom raha hai. ω, speed, centripetal acceleration?
examples.solution: ω = 120 × 2π/60 = 4π ≈ 12.57 rad/s.  v = ωr = 6.28 m/s.  a_c = ω²r = 79 m/s² (centre ki taraf).

examples.title: Baarish aur chhata
examples.problem: Baarish seedhi 6 m/s se gir rahi hai, aadmi 8 m/s se chal raha hai. Use baarish kis speed aur angle par dikhegi?
examples.solution: v_rain,man = v_rain − v_man ⇒ magnitude √(36 + 64) = 10 m/s, vertical se tan⁻¹(8/6) ≈ 53.1° aage se aati dikhegi. Chhata itna hi aage jhukao.

examples.title: v–t graph se doori
examples.problem: Body 4 s mein 0 se 20 m/s, phir 6 s tak 20 m/s, phir 2 s mein ruk jaati hai. Total doori aur average speed?

topics.title: Frame of reference
topics.explain: Motion hamesha kisi observer ke relative hoti hai. Train mein baitha aadmi apne liye rest par hai, platform ke liye moving. Jis frame mein Newton ke niyam seedhe chalte hain (no acceleration) woh inertial frame; sawal mein ground ko inertial maante hain.

topics.title: Uniform vs non-uniform motion
topics.explain: Uniform motion: barabar time mein barabar displacement (a = 0, x–t seedhi line). Non-uniform: velocity badalti hai. Uniformly accelerated motion mein v–t seedhi line hoti hai aur x–t parabola.

topics.title: Graph padhna
topics.explain: x–t graph ka slope velocity; curve upar mud raha hai to velocity badh rahi hai. v–t ka slope acceleration aur area displacement. Kabhi bhi x–t graph mein ek hi time par do x nahi ho sakte, aur speed negative nahi hoti.

topics.title: Scalars and vectors
topics.explain: Scalar ka sirf magnitude (mass, speed, kaam, energy); vector ka magnitude + direction (displacement, velocity, force). Vectors ko triangle/parallelogram law se jodte hain; subtraction = ulta vector jodna. Do vectors ka resultant |A − B| se |A + B| ke beech hi hota hai.

topics.title: Motion in a plane
topics.explain: x aur y motions ek doosre se independent hain — dono ka time common. Isliye projectile ko 'horizontal uniform + vertical free fall' maan kar hal karte hain. Position vector r = xî + yĵ, velocity v = dr/dt.

topics.title: Projectile ke important facts
topics.explain: Top par speed minimum (u cosθ) aur velocity horizontal. Complementary angles (θ, 90° − θ) par range same. R = 4H cotθ. Range max 45° par. Air resistance nahi maante.

topics.title: Uniform circular motion
topics.explain: Velocity har point par tangent par; acceleration centre ki taraf (centripetal) aur magnitude v²/r. Ek chakkar mein displacement zero, average velocity zero, lekin average speed 2πr/T.

topics.title: Relative motion ke sawal
topics.explain: Do cheezon ke beech doori ka sawal: ek ko rest maan lo aur doosre ko relative velocity do — sawal 1-D ban jaata hai. Rain–man, boat–river, do trains — sab v_AB = v_A − v_B.

ratta: v = u + at,  s = ut + ½at²,  v² = u² + 2as,  s_n = u + a(2n − 1)/2.
Free fall from rest: v = √(2gh), t = √(2h/g).
Projectile: T = 2u sinθ/g, H = u² sin²θ/2g, R = u² sin2θ/g, R_max = u²/g.
R = 4H cotθ;  θ aur 90° − θ par same range.
Equal distances par average speed = 2v₁v₂/(v₁ + v₂).
A·B = AB cosθ;  |A×B| = AB sinθ = parallelogram area.
River: shortest time t = d/v_b;  shortest path sinθ = v_r/v_b.
